title: Fix Rerun stream regression: remove depth point cloud and restore image views
objective: Repair examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py after the previous Rerun camera/frustum change: keep the world-frame camera frustum and RGB image projection, but restore normal 2D image streams for RGB/depth/normals/diffuse and prevent depth from appearing as a 3D point cloud.
instructions: Do not log depth under the camera pinhole entity, because Rerun back-projects camera-child DepthImage as a point cloud in the 3D view.
Keep  as the world-frame camera pose plus visible frustum/pinhole.
Keep one RGB image child under the camera only if needed for the 3D projected image plane/frustum projection.
Restore ordinary 2D image streams for inspection under a non-camera path, preferably , , , and . These should show up as images, not 3D point clouds.
Depth should be visible as a 2D depth image/visualization and must not create a 3D point cloud by default.
Preserve the improved color handling for RGB/diffuse/normals where it is correct, but make the paths and names clear.
Update README/docs only to match the corrected behavior.
constraints: Do not remove the programmatic control feature.
Do not run live simulator-dependent commands.
expected_outputs: Patched script and docs restoring image visibility and removing the unwanted point cloud.
definition_of_done: Static check confirms no  is logged under .
ResultPacket explains exactly which Rerun paths now show camera/frustum, projected RGB, 2D images, trajectory, and status.
